usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog and ScreenshotEngine captures web pages, so “New Product” can run “Capture Website Screenshot”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Capture Website Screenshot” in ScreenshotEngine
bestTemplate.why: Each new product page gets a screenshot, and the action returns a public image URL.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” fires on every edit, so one order can trigger several screenshots.
